ticks.note: Accepted: the cycle A -> B -> A has only immediate transitions at the top level (an untriggered join to is immediate), but every trip round it passes the delayed A1 -> A2 inside A, so no tick can go round twice. Tick 1 enters A and A1.
A1 -> A2 (delayed), so A's region is final; the join fires at once, B's immediate transition re-enters A (x = 1) and A1 waits again. taken = [1, 1, 1] (order: A's join, A1 -> A2, B -> A).
Once more round the cycle: x = 3.
